title: Internal Algebraic Type Theory
summary: This thesis brings us closer to applying computer-assisted, internal, type-theoretic reasoning to a category, with examples in the category of cubical sets, the category of groupoids, and the category of categories. The steps we make towards this general goal are both in furthering the type theoretic analysis of these examples, as well as implementing computer-assisted syntax-semantic reasoning as part of the HoTTLean project.
